title: Make independently resampled audio chunks join exactly

definition.title: Make independently resampled audio chunks join exactly
definition.source_excerpt: Address jobs by absolute output-sample intervals and provide the finite filter's input halo and global phase. Compare irregularly partitioned execution with the same continuous resampler including edges, delays and sample counts.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Write the exact requested signal operation, codec tool constraints, state and rounding contract. Check whether an optimized existing library already performs it.
definition.minimum_probe: A tiny independent numerical/bitstream oracle plus one boundary or adversarial case. Only use a matching Wasm slice when available and inexpensive.
definition.initial_screen: Write the exact requested signal operation, codec tool constraints, state and rounding contract. Check whether an optimized existing library already performs it. A tiny independent numerical/bitstream oracle plus one boundary or adversarial case. Only use a matching Wasm slice when available and inexpensive.
definition.primary_metric: Complete specified audio operation, output sample count/phase and practical CPU/memory or repeated-query cost.
definition.scope_contract: Exact PCM/encoded output where claimed; otherwise declared numeric tolerance against a stronger independent reference, including delay, tails and state.
definition.negative_control: Extrema, invalid precision, changed predictor/phase/history or a nonlinear stage must invalidate assumptions. No covert resampling/downmix/quality change.
definition.stop_boundary: No full DSP pipeline or codec-state subsystem in the first pass. Count preparation/queries and do not promote algebra alone as an integrated gain.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Pinned processing recipe and relevant assets. Distinguish aggregate statistics from waveform, loudness, true peak and physical speaker behavior.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.
